description: This file defines a Catalyst plugin role for generating static resource URIs, supporting configuration-based base URIs or default static directory paths.

classes.name: Coocook::Plugin::UriForStatic
classes.description: A Moose role providing a method to generate static resource URIs in a Catalyst application.

methods.name: uri_for_static
methods.description: Generates a URI for static resources, either relative to a configured base URI or within the default static directory.
